Kolkata Restaurants Offer Durga Puja Buffets and Extra Trains

Kolkata restaurants are preparing festive buffets and global cuisine for Durga Puja 2026. Additionally, Sealdah railway station will operate more evening and overnight trains during the peak days of the Durga Puja festival to accommodate increased passenger traffic.
